title: Cute Toy Figurine (SDXL)
description: Blind-box toy figurine aesthetic, popular for designer toy marketing, Funko-style product shots, and social media content.

prompt.main: cute designer toy figurine of a cat astronaut, glossy vinyl material with matte finish on helmet, tiny detailed oxygen tank on back, standing on a small rotating display base, pop mart style, isolated on white background, product photography --ar 1:1

tutorial.intro: Designer toy = "vinyl material" + "glossy + matte" + "display base" + named brand. Pop Mart / Funko is the reference.
steps: Subject: cute designer toy figurine of a cat astronaut 鈥?designer toy + specific character.
Material: glossy vinyl material with matte finish on helmet 鈥?vinyl + dual finish (the toy code).
Detail: tiny detailed oxygen tank on back 鈥?small detail = premium toy.
Display: standing on a small rotating display base 鈥?base = collectible packaging.
Reference: pop mart style, isolated on white background, product photography 鈥?name the brand + format.
tutorial.tips: "Pop Mart style" or "Funko Pop" instantly triggers the designer toy aesthetic. The "rotating display base" is the collector's tell.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "designer toy figurine, cat astronaut, pop mart style --ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --s 600".
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A cute designer toy figurine of a cat astronaut in Pop Mart style, vinyl material, on a white background".

faq.q: Why does my toy look like a 3D render?
faq.a: You forgot "vinyl material" + "matte + gloss". That combination is the designer toy material code.

faq.q: How to make it look premium?
faq.a: Tiny details (oxygen tank) + display base + "Pop Mart" reference. Details = premium toy pricing.
1:1 ratio with white background. Product shot format reads as "merch" instantly.
